preconditions.description: The input strings a and b are not empty.

preconditions.expression: all(c in '01' for c in a) and all(c in '01' for c in b)
preconditions.description: The input strings a and b consist only of characters '0' and '1'.
The length of the input strings a and b does not exceed 10^6.

postconditions.expression: output == 'YES' if can_transform(a, b) else output == 'NO'
postconditions.description: The output is 'YES' if and only if it is possible to transform string a into string b using the described operations.
